# David Silverlight Portfolio

> David Silverlight is a senior .NET MAUI and Xamarin.Forms developer specializing in enterprise mobile apps, Xamarin-to-.NET MAUI migrations, healthcare, GIS, logistics, fintech, IoT, and mobile performance work. He also ships client-side web front ends in React and Angular.

David is based in Miami, Florida and is available for senior mobile development, consulting, modernization, migration, and project rescue work.

## Key Pages

- [Portfolio Home](https://davidsilverlight.com/): Overview of David Silverlight's mobile, web, Silverlight, Xamarin.Forms, and .NET MAUI work.
- [RamTech gMobile Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/RamTech%20gMobile.html): .NET MAUI Esri/ArcGIS field-inspection app for damage assessment, leak survey, and gas-insight inspections.
- [ATrack Mobile Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/ATrack%20Mobile.html): .NET MAUI clinical data-collection app RBTs use in ABA therapy sessions.
- [ATrack Solutions Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/ATrack%20Solutions.html): React clinician web platform for ABA providers — VB-MAPP, Vineland and ABLLS-R assessment integration, a 5,000+ item goal recommendation engine, treatment planning, TrueNote billing-ready session notes, and filterable clinical analytics; the companion to ATrack Mobile.
- [Kudurru Stone Web Client Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/Kudurru%20Stone%20Web%20Client.html): Office-side React web client for land-survey firms. Covers the branded client portal with custom request forms and tracking references, one-step request-to-project conversion with optional QuickBooks sync, and the dashboard, clients, project detail, crew availability and weekly scheduler; the companion to the Kudurru Stone .NET MAUI field app.
- [UPS Mobile Delivery Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/UPS%20Mobile%20Delivery.html): .NET MAUI feasibility and component work for enterprise delivery handhelds.
- [KudurruStone Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/KudurruStone.html): .NET MAUI crew scheduling, time tracking, and route mapping for field operations.
- [Kinship Navigator Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/Kinship%20Navigator.html): .NET MAUI social-services app connecting kinship caregivers to state programs.
- [BCBS My BluePrint Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/BCBS%20-%20My%20BluePrint.html): Healthcare member app (claims, benefits, contact) built with Xamarin.Forms.
- [T-Mobile Money Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/T-Mobile%20Money.html): Fintech mobile banking app built with Xamarin.Forms.
- [Marcel Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/Marcel.html): Xamarin.Forms professional network and daily-digest app for Publicis Groupe.
- [UAS Trakker Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/UAS%20Trakker.html): GIS/drone search-and-rescue mapping app.
- [Stratusphere API Builder Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/Stratusphere%20API%20Builder.html): Angular 9 + NgRx graphical query builder that lets Liquidware customers interrogate millions of rows of workspace telemetry without hand-writing REST calls.
- [Time & Expense Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.com/Sherlock%20Talent%20Time%20and%20Expenses.html): React Native and TypeScript time-and-expense app with one-tap billable punch, offline-first sync, receipt OCR, and manager approvals in a neumorphic soft-UI system.
- [Resume](https://davidsilverlight.com/David%20Silverlight%20Resume.html): David Silverlight's resume.
